messages:
Ava (sec-eng): Heads-up: after the RBAC tighten for region-keystore we saw intermittent mTLS failures in ap-south during a rotator rollout.
Ravi (infra): Any sample log?
Ava (sec-eng): Proxy snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T18:20:11Z proxy-ap tls: unwrap error: KMS AccessDenied principal=service-account/rotator-role key=alias/region-keystore
```
Chen (sre): Correlates with a 45s spike of 502s from svc-ingest -> svc-normalize at ~18:20. Canary group affected first.
AuditBot: Alert KMS-DENY-20260322: 12 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/service-account/rotator-role between 2026-03-22T18:19:50Z and 2026-03-22T18:20:40Z. Logs archived to /logs/sec/kms/2026-03-22/KMS-DENY-20260322.json
Ravi (infra): Quick mitigation: grant kms:Decrypt to service-account/proxy-fanout for alias/region-keystore for 20m via infra pipeline and raise proxy cache TTL to 5m on canary. No console changes.
Chen (sre): I'll run emergency job: `./infra/iam-emerg --grant "proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 20m --tag incident-mtls-ap-south`
DeployBot: Job j-3310 started by Chen (sre). Command logged.
Chen (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/4, cache TTL bumped. Error rate back to baseline within ~30s. No more denies after regrant.
Ava (sec-eng): Postmortem actions: 1) add RBAC preflight that simulates KMS decrypt as rotator principal, 2) increase default proxy cache TTL to 3m, 3) change rotator to serve cached chain on decrypt failure + circuit-breaker, 4) store KMS deny events with 90d retention.
Ravi (infra): I'll open infra PR for the preflight check and IAM gating in rollout pipeline. Sample check: `aws kms decrypt --key-id alias/region-keystore --profile rotator-principal || exit 1`
Chen (sre): Also adding an observability rule: fail canary if KMS Deny > 0 for 1m.
Ava (sec-eng): I'll own the PM for the postmortem and collate artifacts (KMS denies, IAM diffs, proxy cache metrics).
Chen (sre): Linking incident SEC-4728 once PR + postmortem live. Closing thread unless new alerts. :lock:
